project_info.theme: New product hero poster for Hau Giang lotus mineral sun fluid

main_subject.detail: A clean vertical product-launch poster centered on a white Cocoon Hau Giang lotus mineral sun fluid bottle with black cap and visible SPF 50+ broad spectrum labeling, set against a blue-to-pink gradient background with reflection below.
main_subject.style: Minimal premium skincare hero poster, glossy retail launch visual

composition_elements.text: Visible text includes 'MỚI', 'SỮA CHỐNG NẮNG VÔ CƠ SEN HẬU GIANG', 'NÂNG TÔNG TỰ NHIÊN, BẢO VỆ CAO CHO DA RẤT NHẠY CẢM', and bottle text including 'SPF 50+ QUANG PHỔ RỘNG BROAD SPECTRUM PA++++' and 'TONE-UP BEIGE'.
items: Top Left: Pink rectangle containing the word 'MỚI' above the main headline.
Top Right: Open blue gradient negative space supporting the large white headline stack.
Bottom Left: Faint reflection of the bottle on the glossy base.
Bottom Right: Beige badge on the product reading 'TONE-UP BEIGE'.
Center/Background: Large centered product bottle with black cap, gold Cocoon logo, and a soft peach gradient at the bottom.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Clean bottle highlights, subtle gloss reflection, premium launch polish, even readability

technical_specs.render_style: High fidelity beauty product poster design

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality advertising poster for a new skincare launch. Centerpiece is a white Cocoon Hau Giang lotus mineral sun fluid bottle with black cap, gold logo, and visible SPF 50+ broad spectrum labeling, centered on a glossy reflective base. Background is a sky-blue to soft peach gradient. Surrounding elements: a pink tag 'MỚI', the headline 'SỮA CHỐNG NẮNG VÔ CƠ SEN HẬU GIANG', the line 'NÂNG TÔNG TỰ NHIÊN, BẢO VỆ CAO CHO DA RẤT NHẠY CẢM', and the product badge 'TONE-UP BEIGE'. Keep the minimalist vertical hierarchy and clean premium skincare look. Technical style: high fidelity beauty product poster design, soft studio product lighting, clean bottle highlights and subtle gloss reflection, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
prompt.negative_prompt: dark, gloomy, blurry, flat 2d, low resolution, distorted text, messy typography, muted colors, black and white, ugly, deformed shapes, watermark, signature, cropped
